finalists.label: Neutrophilic panniculitis
finalists.why: It has the most specific and decisive findings, including a dense acute neutrophilic infiltrate extending into adipose tissue and septa.

finalists.label: Vasculitis
finalists.why: It has a range of systemic findings, including intermittent fever and elevated C-reactive protein level, but is weakened by negative direct immunofluorescence of the lesion.

finalists.label: Autoimmune Hepatitis
finalists.why: It is a pre-existing condition but lacks specific findings in the vignette to support its reactivation or flare-up as the primary cause of the current symptoms.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen because it has the most specific histopathological evidence, including a dense acute neutrophilic infiltrate extending into adipose tissue and septa, which is not fully explained by the runner-up.
